name: std::make_error_condition(std::io_errc)
intro: Constructs an std::error_condition object from a value of type std::io_errc as if by return std::error_condition(static_cast<int>(e), std::iostream_category()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A value of type std::error_condition that holds the error code number from e associated with the error category "iostream".

examples.output:
error condition for io_errc::stream has value 1
and message "unspecified iostream_category error"
